r: I have found some bones. May I enter now?
Could you tell me something about this place?
Oh, it's nothing. I just tried the bell.
Please give me back my cheese.
Please give me back my cheese.
Please give me back my cheese.
Please give me back my cheese.

ratdom_rat_warden_10.m: I am the warden of our Memorial Hall. I keep the exhibits in order and answer questions from visitors. Call me Wart.
r: Could you tell me anything about this place?

ratdom_rat_warden_30.m: This used to be a happy place of memories. Many objects and statues from the past invite you to linger and think. Every rat loved this place.

ratdom_rat_warden_32.m: But Fraedro was filled with jealousy and consumed with envy.
r: Yes, it is always the same thing.
Sigh. I know that story already. Get to the point.

ratdom_rat_warden_33.m: How he hated it when visitors crowded these halls around the valuable exhibits and admired the statues.

ratdom_rat_warden_34.m: He wanted to be the center of attention. A larger-than-life statue of himself should dominate the room, he thought.

ratdom_rat_warden_35.m: He hated especially the fully preserved skeleton of King Rah, the powerful founder of this empire. It was particularly brilliant: King Rah, standing upright, his dreaded sword in his bony right hand.

ratdom_rat_warden_36.m: Yes, King Rah was a great leader. Many battles were fought against the monsters that came out of the rift. But when the superiority became too great, Rah led his people into the caves under the Blackwater Mountains and founded a new empire there.

ratdom_rat_warden_37.m: The wise King Rah had the existing caves further expanded as protection.
r: That's why the passages are laid out so confusingly?

ratdom_rat_warden_38.m: Right. This should be additional protection from enemies.
r: Interesting. But why is the passage here closed now?

ratdom_rat_warden_40.m: One bad day I found this place ransacked! Only an empty pedestal remained where the richly decorated skeleton of King Rah had been.

ratdom_rat_warden_42.m: This was probably Fraedro's most terrifying act. We found him and confronted him.

ratdom_rat_warden_44.m: Of course he denied everything, that hypocrite! But who else could have done it?

ratdom_rat_warden_44a.m: He deserved immediate death for this terrible act. However, we only locked him up until he would reveal where he stashed our beloved royal skeleton.

ratdom_rat_warden_44b.m: For security reasons, we don't let anyone in or out until King Rah is back in his accustomed place.
r: Even 100 pieces of gold wouldn't change your mind?
If the skeleton is back, may I pass?
I want to talk with Fraedro.
What lies behind this blocked passage?

ratdom_rat_warden_44d.m: And another tunnel, but only a short distance and a dead end.

ratdom_rat_warden_44e.m: We never go there, there are scary noises coming from there.
r: Finally light at the end of the tunnel.

ratdom_rat_warden_46a.m: Of course not! This door will remain closed until King Rah returns.

ratdom_rat_warden_48.m: If King Rah is with us again, that would be great! Of course you can then go to our memory hall. You would be our guest of honor.

ratdom_rat_warden_48a.m: But we are not there yet.

ratdom_rat_warden_52.m:
Let's have a look. Oh, what are my old eyes seeing? King Rah is back, completely! I am overwhelmed with joy!
You may pass now of course.
r: I hope you can puzzle your king back together.

ratdom_rat_warden_60.m: Wonderful! You've already recovered King Rah's head!

ratdom_rat_warden_61.m: You've already recovered some of King Rah's legs.

ratdom_rat_warden_65.m: Ah, you've already recovered King Rah's tail!

ratdom_rat_warden_66.m: Good, you've already recovered King Rah's back bone.

ratdom_rat_warden_67.m: Great! These bones look like King Rah's ribs!

ratdom_rat_warden_69.m: Please go and find all of King Rah's bones.

ratdom_rat_warden_70a.m: Let's have a look ... Great! Only King Rah's head is missing. You will find it too, I am sure.
r: I hope it is worth the hard work.

ratdom_rat_warden_71a.m: Let's have a look ... Great! Now we only need the fourth leg. You will find it too, I am sure.
r: I hope it is worth the hard work.

ratdom_rat_warden_75a.m: Let's have a look ... Great! Only King Rah's tail is missing. You will find it too, I am sure.
r: I hope it is worth the hard work.

ratdom_rat_warden_76a.m: Let's have a look ... Great! Only King Rah's back bone is missing. You will find it too, I am sure.
r: I hope it is worth the hard work.

ratdom_rat_warden_77a.m: Let's have a look ... Great! Only King Rah's rib bones are missing. You will find them too, I am sure.
r: I hope it is worth the hard work.

ratdom_rat_warden_79.m: Let's have a look ... In total we need the head, the ribs and the back bone, 4 legs and the tail of course.

ratdom_rat_warden_80.m: I can't let you enter our Memorial Hall. We have to get back our skeleton statue of King Rah first.
r: OK. I will find the bones for you.
This maze is terrible. Do you have any idea how I could find my way out again?
Do you have any idea where I should go looking for your bones?

ratdom_rat_warden_82.m: That is easy. Just choose the exit where you see rats in front of it. Rats always know their way out.

r: You talk all the time and too much anyway. I can't always listen to that.

ratdom_rat_warden_90.m: The cave system is huge and really very confusing. It already surprised me how you found your way to me here.

ratdom_rat_warden_91.m: Maybe you'll find wisdom in my compass?

ratdom_rat_warden_92.m: Start at the entrance where you entered the lower part of these caves.

ratdom_rat_warden_94.m: There you put on the necklace with my compass. With this compass you may perceive otherwise invisible signs on the walls. Follow these.

ratdom_rat_warden_95.m: Shields in orange and yellow color. Orange for the main route and yellow for short side tunnels.

ratdom_rat_warden_95_10.m: Should there be a branch, there will be an additional flag. The side trip is marked with a yellow shield.

ratdom_rat_warden_95_20.m: Sigh. If you see an orange shield together with a flag, then first look for another passage marked with a yellow shield.

ratdom_rat_warden_95_30.m: Follow this passage to the end. You might find something important there. Then go back to the crossing and follow the orange shield again.

ratdom_rat_warden_95_40.m: [muttering] I want to hope so, but I don't really believe it yet.

ratdom_rat_warden_95_41.m: [muttering] I want to hope so, but I don't really believe it yet.

ratdom_rat_warden_96.m: It will be a far journey. But you will meet everything that you need to meet. And even more.

ratdom_rat_warden_98.m: Beware! It slows you down, because your mind is clouded and partly in another dimension.
r: No problem. Show me this wonderful item.
However, I am as poor as a church rat.

ratdom_rat_warden_99.m: Well, I have too good a heart. Here, take the amulet for 100 gold pieces.
r: Oh thank you! Here is the gold.
Thank you. Here, have some coins.
Wasn't there one or two more pieces of cheese?

ratdom_rat_warden_cheese_54.m: Insolence. I'll pretend that I didn't hear it.

ratdom_quest.10: I woke up when I felt that something had bitten my toe. Apparently I had a nightmare - there were rats everywhere! Anyway, I wasn't even slightly recovered.
ratdom_quest.30: An ancient meditating man rewarded me with a rat skull for a wise discussion.
ratdom_quest.31: I took a leg bone of a rat from a gold hunter.
ratdom_quest.32: I stole a leg bone of a rat from the instrument maker.
ratdom_quest.33: In the center of a labyrinth I found a leg bone of a rat.
ratdom_quest.34: I took a leg bone of a rat from the dancing but vengeful and unforgiving skeletons.
ratdom_quest.35: I found the tail bones of a dead rat on a platform in a lake.
ratdom_quest.36: In a library I found the back bone of a big rat.
ratdom_quest.37: I got some rib bones of a rat from the skeleton leader.
ratdom_quest.50: A small, naughty rat called Clevred claimed that he could help me get out of here. In return, he required of me to help to find a yellow, round artifact.
ratdom_quest.52: I should look around in the rat cave. Clevred probably meant the Crossglen's supply cave.
ratdom_quest.60: In the depth of the supply cave I found a new statue, that resembles to my brother Andor.
ratdom_quest.70: The rats had erected the statue in honor of Andor for never killing rats. I should begin your search behind this statue.
ratdom_quest.80: I would need a pickaxe to tear down the statue.
ratdom_quest.82: Audir, the smith of Crossglen, sold me an old, sturdy pickaxe.
ratdom_quest.90: I tore down the statue of Andor. Behind it in the wall I found a hole in the shape of a bone.
ratdom_quest.100: I have put a bone into the hole, and the wall crumbled to dust.
ratdom_quest.110: A torch could help to see in the dark. Unfortunately, the torch is so heavy, that I would have to lift it with both hands.
ratdom_quest.120: I found a platform with a good view over Crossglen. Andor seemed to have been here many times.
ratdom_quest.200:
I found an exit from the caves to the surface. Cold icy wind was swirling up here on the Black Water mountain top. 
Astonishingly I wasn't alone here - Whootibarfag, a very old hermit seemed to have been waiting for me.
ratdom_quest.210: Whootibarfag was delighted with my help in rescuing Rat King Rah's skeleton. As a thank you, he let me in on the secret of the rat escape. This increased my ability to flee.
ratdom_quest.310: Wart, the warden to the halls of memory told me, that the access would be closed, until the rat memorial is restored. I should seek the bones of King Rah's skeleton.
ratdom_quest.320: Wart told me that he needed the head, the ribs and the back bone, 4 legs and the tail.
ratdom_quest.321: Wart said that I just have to find the skull.
ratdom_quest.322: Wart said that I just have to find the back bone.
ratdom_quest.323: Wart said that I have to find the rib bones.
ratdom_quest.324: Wart said that I just have to find the tail.
ratdom_quest.325: Wart said that I just have to find the fourth leg.
ratdom_quest.380: I donated King Rah's sword to the memory hall.
ratdom_quest.381: I sold King Rah's sword to the memory hall.
ratdom_quest.390: Wart was glad to have his rat memorial restored. He granted access to the memory hall now.
ratdom_quest.392: Wart told me that Fraedro was captured.
ratdom_quest.395: Wart allowed me to go deeper into the cave and have a word with Fraedro.
ratdom_quest.398: I believed in Fraedro's innocence and released him.
ratdom_quest.399: I attacked Fraedro to avenge the theft of King Rah.
ratdom_quest.400: I tried Fraedro's tiny golden key in a hole of the cavewall near to his prison. Immediatly the wall gave way to another passage.
ratdom_quest.900: I finally found the yellow artifact: It was a big round and smelly cheese! Golden yellow and so large that it would provide almost unlimited food. Clevred was overjoyed!
ratdom_quest.940: I told Clevred that I you couldn't help him further with the search. He then left me to search on his own.
ratdom_quest.942: Although I had told Clevred that I couldn't help him further with the search and he then left me, I met him in the caves again. I have decided to start the search again.
ratdom_quest.948: The big yellow cheese now weighs heavily in my bag. Small consolation for the loss of a friend, though.
ratdom_quest.950:
I fought my way through the roundlings. But Clevred was seriously wounded in the fight. He was just able to give me his beloved artifact. 
With a last breath he thanked me for my company and died in my arms.
ratdom_quest.960: I persuaded Clevred to leave the artifact behind. Clevred obeyed disappointedly, but he left me on the spot.
ratdom_quest.999: I fell asleep just in front of my bed. After long hours of deep and dreamless sleep I woke up - all the rats were gone! Was it only a dream?

sk.fightstyleUnarmedUnarmored: Fighting style: Way of the monk
